model.name: Maex and De Schutter 1998 cerebellar granule cell (Granule_98)
model.citation: Maex R, De Schutter E (1998). Synchronization of Golgi and Granule Cell Firing in a Detailed Network Model of the Cerebellar Granule Cell Layer. Journal of Neurophysiology 80(5):2521-2537. doi:10.1152/jn.1998.80.5.2521
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment (10 um); NaF, KDr, KA, KCa, CaHVA, H (Ih), Ca pool. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): silent at rest; rheobase 0.0051 nA; tonic non-adapting firing (ISI ratio 0.93); sag ratio 0.23 at -0.0051 nA (recovery 5.2 mV), near zero at -0.010 and -0.015 nA; no rebound. Ih-block control: at -0.0051 nA sag and recovery fall to 0 and the end-of-step potential is 33.6 mV lower; rest is 5.3 mV more negative; the -0.015 nA block run aborted in jLEMS. 0.05 nA steps abort jLEMS (GOhm input resistance).
model.inclusion_reason: Candidate with caveats: no single-cell harness shipped (canonical protocol must be authored or the model excluded from canonical comparison); default rheobase bracket (0.5 nA) crashes jLEMS; Ih sag is Ih-dependent in the block control but weak and present only at the mildest step.
